name: tick-stock-panel
description: TSP自托管、零运维的 A 股「选股 + 监控 + 回测」量化工作台 | LLM能力驱使策略定制+个股分析+复盘 | 自由接入第三方数据源与个性化扩展数据 | 个人开源
one_liner: A self-hosted dashboard for picking, watching, and backtesting Chinese (A-share) stocks, using AI to help build and review trading strategies.
buyer: An individual retail investor in China who actively trades A-shares and wants a private, self-hosted alternative to paid quant platforms without sending their strategy data to a third party.
business_use_cases: A retail trader self-hosts it to backtest a strategy before risking real money, instead of paying for a commercial platform subscription.
A small trading club deploys a shared instance so members pool data-source access and strategies.
A fintech tinkerer forks it to build a niche paid version for a specific market segment (e.g. Hong Kong stocks) they understand well.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, done-for-you version for traders who don't want to self-host and maintain it.
Sell premium data-source integrations or strategy templates on top of the free tool.

steal_this: Host a managed instance this weekend for a handful of trader friends and charge a small monthly fee to handle the hosting and data-source setup for them.
